description_en: Shares an image with other Alibaba Cloud accounts, or unshares an image from the recipient Alibaba Cloud accounts
description_zh: 将镜像共享给无影的其他用户或者取消已经共享的镜像
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-image-permission --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-gx2x1dhsmusr20000 --add-account 1182725234310000 --remove-account 1149842128760000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyImagePermission
